name: MAI
oneLiner: MAI is QiDao's overcollateralized stablecoin minted against crypto vault collateral across 15 chains; currently in a sustained soft depeg below $0.99.
collateral: Overcollateralized crypto vault collateral across QiDao markets, including bridged and wrapped assets
pegMechanism: Borrowers mint MAI against overcollateralized vault positions and repay or liquidate through QiDao market rules

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Explicit Yes retained: reviewed metadata indicates a direct issuer, admin, proxy, pause, burn, or upgrade control surface beyond reserve-only exposure.

notices.title: Soft depeg below $0.99
notices.message: MAI has been trading around $0.987 across all 15 supported chains; CDP redemption pressure is not currently restoring parity.

mintAuthority.summary: MAI is minted across 15 chains by borrowing against overcollateralized QiDao vault positions; QiDao governance (QI holders) plus an admin multisig control vault onboarding, debt ceilings, and risk parameters.

controls.label: QiDao vault/minter contracts
controls.capDescription: MAI is minted only by borrowers against overcollateralized QiDao vaults under per-vault debt ceilings; supply expands and contracts with collateralized borrowing and repayment/liquidation, not an issuer minter.
controls.evidence: QiDao docs describe borrowers minting MAI against overcollateralized vault positions and repaying or being liquidated per market rules across supported chains.

controls.label: QiDao governance + admin multisig
controls.capDescription: QiDao governance (QI holders) and an admin multisig onboard new vaults, set debt ceilings and risk parameters, and can authorize new minting vaults across the 15 supported chains.
controls.evidence: QiDao governance (QI) plus an admin multisig administer vault onboarding and debt-ceiling/risk parameters; MAI metadata records a direct admin/upgrade control surface beyond reserve-only exposure.

review.evidence: QiDao documentation describes MAI as an overcollateralized multi-chain CDP stablecoin minted from vault positions, with QI governance and an admin multisig controlling vault onboarding and debt ceilings.
review.sourceFreeRationale: CDP mint mechanism and QI-governance/multisig control confirmed from QiDao docs; the admin multisig signer set/threshold and per-chain vault admins were not independently read on-chain.
unresolvedQuestions: Resolve the QiDao admin multisig (signers, threshold) and per-chain vault/minter authorization addresses before raising confidence.
